Supplier A’s order is due on 26 Oct. The forecast shows a BDT 19,000 shortfall against the original BDT 60,000 order. Trimming it would save BDT 10,800, leaving BDT 8,200 to cover. The trim is based on the slow mover: only 12 of 30 boxes are expected to sell before expiry.

I proposed trimming the order and asking Supplier A for 20 more days on the remaining BDT 8,200. If the supplier does not agree, a mobile-wallet loan is the fallback; its cost is BDT 181.97.

These actions are waiting for your approval in Actions. Until approved, payment is not assured.
